license_and_corresponding_source_audit.evidence: Reviewed matching source and recipes for the pinned ADB/scrcpy/AppImage dependencies and the rebuilt FFmpeg 8.1.2 decoder. Verified inner source checksums for 29 source archives, required notices, Flutter notices and new multicast_dns/qr/qr_flutter licenses and component SBOM entries. Source archives contain no private development instruction files.

off_device_signing_key_recovery.evidence: Protected GitHub release-environment secrets hold an encrypted off-device copy of the permanent keystore and password. This exercises recovery from the remote copy. Local private key and additional local backup remain available. Retain account recovery access and preferably another encrypted offline copy.
